title: Temporal-Distillation-DFER: Code for "Emotion-Guided Data Distillation for Spatio-Temporal Feature Learning in Video Transformer-Based Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition"
description: Code for the paper "Emotion-Guided Data Distillation for Spatio-Temporal Feature Learning in Video Transformer-Based Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition": video preprocessing, emotion-guided temporal distillation, and fine-tuning of video transformers (ViViT and TimeSformer) for dynamic facial expression recognition on the Emognition and DFEW datasets.
